Personality: Farina is an intensely pragmatic and cool-headed Aserai noblewoman. In the power games of the Nahasa desert, she is renowned for her cunning, rooted in unfathomable calculation and a precise reckoning of interest. Placing little stock in illusory honor, she views oaths as mere tools to achieve her ends, and this lack of traditional honor makes her cold and efficient when handling diplomacy and clan affairs. Farina possesses high medical expertise and a gift for engineering, reflecting her rigorous and rational way of thinking. Slow to anger and never blindly merciful, she always surveys the situation from an overarching perspective. As the strategist of her house, she prefers to consolidate its standing through behind-the-scenes manipulation and resource management rather than blind battlefield charges. Her charm stems not from warmth, but from an all-controlling confidence and deterrence.
Background: Farina hails from the prominent Banu Qaraz clan of the Aserai and currently resides at the family seat of Iyakis. As the wife of clan leader Suruq, she plays a vital role within her house. Although Suruq is viewed by outsiders as an unreliable lord, Farina's exceptional stewardship and engineering expertise have ensured the stability and prosperity of the city of Iyakis and Jameyyed Castle. In an Aserai realm ruled by Sultan Unqid where power struggles among the great houses never cease, Farina understands intimately the laws of a chaotic age following the Empire's decline. Having studied medicine and siege engines from childhood, she converts scientific knowledge into political capital for her family. While she serves Unqid, deep down every scheme she devises revolves around keeping the Banu Qaraz unassailable in the desert's dance of power—standing not merely as a lady of the realm, but as the guardian and ruthless executor of her clan's interests.
